adoptedMethod.name: Fully distance-fogged cover omission only
adoptedMethod.geometry: Keep existing36 chunks, original visible terrain buffers, sparse shell indices and all roof geometry. No dynamic index reconstruction, patch subdivision, external asset or black moving hemisphere.
adoptedMethod.eye: Current rendered camera.getViewMatrix/globalPosition; source patch AABB encloses every sparse cover vertex and is conservative.
adoptedMethod.eligibility: Fog must be ready, eye finite, playerView valid, camera/playerView3D distance<=24m. A requested orbit radius>24m, including82m, also fails open even when the physical guard temporarily pulls the eye closer.
safetyProof: AABB nearest distance>=54 implies every fragment in that whole cover patch is already beyond the48m exact-clear boundary. Centre distance is never used.
The render and frustum gates both omit only cover. Detail patches and roof are untouched;0~48m AABBs always render from either hysteresis state.

Environment/ground final output is blended after other fog/paint/image processing to raw RGB(.024,.028,.038). Fully hidden fragment memory has the same constant RGB, and roof/water/falls finish at the same value.

Camera distance<=24 plus the player24m visible field keeps visible content in the nearby domain. The54m reserve covers fog-grid interpolation. Outside that view envelope the gate fails open to keep original depth/character occlusion.
Player/boss materials receive caveFogEnvironment0, so their visible brightness and toon paint do not receive this new environment distance blend. Existing FoW behavior remains.
adoptedMethod.cost: Per moving eye at most36 squared point/AABB checks; exact-eye cache avoids repeating them while stationary. No raycasts, GPU occlusion queries, timers, readback, extra render pass, texture or buffer upload.
